comment: The bridge release's own inputs to the testnet package (briefs/tnb-without-host.md). build-bridge-image.py checks every checkout against these commits before it builds; deploy/testnet/pins.json stays the node image's. dnb-tool is built from the node images' bft pin (deploy/testnet/pins.json, #1075). Native bridge v2 (NB2-09, #1105): contracts at unicity-pos-contracts 884c4829 (#82: src/nb2, the NB2 vault and verifier), the deployment the plug-ins' gas estimate is calibrated for (#1179): the full-project build at contracts main (4fd6b1a3, #91; src/nb2 unchanged, the protocol 6/7 bridge removed by #83; bft-core#1139) compiles a different, 18,886-byte verifier, which the estimate refuses, so this pin moves to main with a recalibration, the plug-ins at native-bridge-plugins main (c9aa3339, #82: the redeem gas estimate estimate-nb2-1179, #1179; on #81: the nb2 wallet plug-in #76, the reference wallet and guide #79), the vectors digest 9b3962dc and the reference wallet (wallet/, NB2-11 #1107), whose core the lane driver imports.
